name: Pallof Press with Overhead Raise
description: The Pallof press with overhead raise extends the standard anti-rotation Pallof press by raising the arms fully overhead after pressing the cable handle out from the chest, dramatically increasing the moment arm and anti-rotation demand on the core. At the overhead position, the torso must resist both rotational and anti-extension forces simultaneously, making this a comprehensive core stability challenge. The movement trains the deep stabilizing musculature of the spine under a large variety of loading directions in a single repetition.

execution.starting_position: Stand side-on to a cable machine with the pulley at chest height. Hold the handle with both hands at the chest, elbows bent. Feet shoulder-width apart, body perpendicular to the cable.
execution.setup_instructions: Set the pulley at chest height. Stand far enough that the cable provides meaningful anti-rotation resistance immediately.
steps: Step 1: Brace the core fully. Press the handle straight out from the chest until the arms are fully extended.
Step 2: Holding the arms straight, raise both arms overhead in a controlled arc until they are fully extended above the head.
Step 3: Pause for 1–2 seconds at the overhead position, resisting the cable pull.
Step 4: Lower the arms back to chest-height horizontal position.
Step 5: Return the handle to the chest. That is one rep. Complete all reps then switch sides.
execution.breathing_instructions: Exhale as pressing out. Hold the breath and brace during overhead phase. Exhale on return.
common_mistakes: Rotating toward the cable during the overhead phase — the spine should remain perfectly perpendicular
Losing the rib-down position as the arms go overhead — indicates insufficient core strength for overhead
safety_considerations: Avoid if shoulder mobility is insufficient for pain-free overhead reach
execution.range_of_motion_guidance: Full extension of the arms horizontally then fully overhead. Spine remains perpendicular to the cable throughout.
execution.tempo_recommendations: 2-2-2-1. Slow and deliberate in every phase.
coaching_cues: Ribs down — do not let the lower back arch as arms go overhead
Resist the pull — your spine does not move
